name: description
data:
<@Cyan>[Module Description]
<@Blue>PSCompletions(<@Magenta>psc<@Cyan>) - A tab-completion manager for PowerShell

<@Cyan>[Module Version]
<@Magenta>{{Version}}<@Cyan>

<@Cyan>[Module Changelog]
GitHub: <@Blue>https://github.com/abgox/PSCompletions/blob/main/module/CHANGELOG.md<@Cyan>
Gitee : <@Blue>https://gitee.com/abgox/PSCompletions/blob/main/module/CHANGELOG.md<@Cyan>

<@Cyan>[Module Usage]
Enter <@Magenta>psc<@Cyan>, press <@Magenta>Space<@Cyan> and <@Magenta>Tab<@Cyan> key, you will quickly learn all usages by reading the completion tip.
Run <@Magenta>psc<@Cyan> will display this page content again and reload the module's key bindings and data.

<@Cyan>[Completion Menu]
<@Blue>PSCompletions<@Cyan> provides a powerful completion menu, built with Rust + Lua.

You can enter to filter:
  - Plain text matches items containing it: <@Magenta>co<@Cyan> finds <@Magenta>config<@Cyan>, <@Magenta>completion<@Cyan>, ...
  - <@Magenta>*<@Cyan> matches any number of characters: <@Magenta>a*d<@Cyan> finds <@Magenta>add<@Cyan>, <@Magenta>and<@Cyan>, ...
  - A leading <@Magenta>^<@Cyan> matches from the start: <@Magenta>^add<@Cyan> only finds items beginning with <@Magenta>add<@Cyan>.
  - A leading <@Magenta>*<@Cyan> switches to subsequence matching (chars in order, not necessarily adjacent): <@Magenta>*vscode<@Cyan> finds <@Magenta>Visual Studio Code<@Cyan>.
  - <@Magenta>**<@Cyan> self-escapes to match a literal asterisk.

Key Bindings:
  - Select previous completion item:  <@Magenta>Up<@Cyan>  | <@Magenta>Shift + Tab<@Cyan> | <@Magenta>Ctrl + u<@Cyan> | <@Magenta>Ctrl + p<@Cyan> | <@Magenta>Ctrl + k<@Cyan>
  - Select   next   completion item: <@Magenta>Down<@Cyan> |     <@Magenta>Tab<@Cyan>     | <@Magenta>Ctrl + d<@Cyan> | <@Magenta>Ctrl + n<@Cyan> | <@Magenta>Ctrl + j<@Cyan>
  - Apply the selected completion item: <@Magenta>Space<@Cyan> | <@Magenta>Enter<@Cyan>
      - You can also use <@Magenta>Tab<@Cyan> when there's only one completion.
  - Move the cursor in the filter area: <@Magenta>Left<@Cyan> | <@Magenta>Right<@Cyan> | <@Magenta>Home<@Cyan> | <@Magenta>End<@Cyan>
  - Delete a filter character: <@Magenta>Backspace<@Cyan> (before the cursor) | <@Magenta>Delete<@Cyan> (after the cursor)
  - Exit the completion menu: <@Magenta>Esc<@Cyan> | <@Magenta>Ctrl + c<@Cyan>
      - You can also use <@Magenta>Backspace<@Cyan> or <@Magenta>Delete<@Cyan> when there're no characters in the filter area.

Mouse Bindings:
  - Scroll wheel: switch the selected item.
  - Left click: select the item under the cursor.
  - Double click: apply the selected item.

Path Completions:
  - Use path identifiers to explicitly get path completions: <@Magenta>/<@Cyan> <@Magenta>./<@Cyan> <@Magenta>../<@Cyan> <@Magenta>~/<@Cyan> | <@Magenta>\<@Cyan> <@Magenta>.\<@Cyan> <@Magenta>..\<@Cyan> <@Magenta>~\<@Cyan>
  - Refer to: <@Blue>https://pscompletions.abgox.com/docs/path-completion<@Cyan>

<@Cyan>[Global Name]
<@Blue>PSCompletions<@Cyan> will take up two global names. <@Yellow>They are read-only, and you should not modify or override them.<@Cyan>
  <@Magenta>PSCompletions<@Cyan>: A function name. The core function of the module export. <@Magenta>psc<@Cyan> is its alias.
 <@Magenta>$PSCompletions<@Cyan>: A variable name. Save all data related to the module.

<@Cyan>[Other Content]
Website : <@Blue>https://pscompletions.abgox.com<@Cyan>
GitHub  : <@Blue>https://github.com/abgox/PSCompletions<@Cyan>
Gitee   : <@Blue>https://gitee.com/abgox/PSCompletions<@Cyan>

If <@Blue>PSCompletions<@Cyan> is helpful to you, please consider giving it a <@Yellow>Star<@Cyan>.
